Adopted Sept. 10, 2024 (effective Sept. 11, 2024) zoning ordinance amendment. Countywide standards applying to every district that permits the use: data center building must be at least 200 ft from the lot line of an adjacent/abutting residential district; ground-mounted equipment (including emergency generators) must be at least 300 ft from a residential district lot line or separated from it by the data center building itself; all equipment must be enclosed within a building.
